name: PR Brief card on the Overview tab and the diff deep link
description: From PR #482, the Overview tab shows the PR Brief card in its empty state (the seed stores no brief, so the card offers 'Generate brief' and no model call is made). Then the ?tab=diff&file=&line= deep link opens src/config.ts expanded and highlighted (line 12 is a new-side line inside the seeded hunk). Text is matched on textContent because the card title is rendered with CSS text-transform: uppercase. Never clicks Generate (flows must not call an LLM). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
